easy.def: A thing with parts that does a job.
examples: A washing machine cleans our clothes.
This machine makes ice.
The machine is very loud.

more.def: A piece of equipment with moving parts that uses power to do work.
examples: The machine at the factory fills a hundred bottles every minute.
A machine at the bank counts the coins.
The farmer uses a machine to pick the corn.

easy.def: A thing that pulls some metal to it.
examples: The magnet stuck to the fridge.
A magnet can pick up a nail.
The magnet holds my drawing up.

more.def: A piece of metal or rock that pulls iron and steel toward it.
examples: We used a magnet to pick up the spilled pins.
A compass needle is a small magnet.
The two magnets snapped together.
The fireworks were magnificent!
The king had a magnificent crown.
What a magnificent rainbow!
From the top of the mountain, the view was magnificent.
The peacock spread its magnificent tail.
The palace has a magnificent hall with gold walls.

easy.def: An animal with fur or hair that feeds milk to its babies.
examples: A dog is a mammal.
A cat is a mammal.
People are mammals too.

more.def: A warm-blooded animal that has hair or fur and feeds its babies with milk.
examples: Whales are mammals, even though they live in the sea.
Bats are the only mammals that can fly.
Like all mammals, a baby elephant drinks its mother's milk.

easy.def: A field of grass and flowers.
examples: Cows eat grass in the meadow.
We ran in the meadow.
Bees buzz in the meadow.

more.def: A field of grass, often with wildflowers.
examples: Butterflies fluttered over the sunny meadow.
A deer and her fawn grazed in the meadow.
The meadow turns yellow with flowers in May.

easy.def: To find out how big, long, or heavy something is.
examples: Let's measure how tall you are.
We measure flour for the cake.
The nurse measured my feet.

more.def: To find the size, amount, or weight of something using a tool like a ruler or scale.
examples: We measured the table to see if it would fit through the door.
Use a ruler to measure the length of the paper.
The cook measured two cups of milk.

easy.def: To say a little bit about something.
examples: Did I mention that I have a new puppy?
She mentioned her new cat.
Did Dad mention the trip?

more.def: To speak or write about something briefly.
examples: She mentioned that the library would be closed on Monday.
The book mentions a secret tunnel under the castle.
He forgot to mention that he would be late.

easy.def: To move to a new place when the season changes.
examples: Some birds migrate when it gets cold.
Whales migrate to warm water.
The geese migrate in the fall.

more.def: To travel from one place to another at certain times of year, as many animals do.
examples: Monarch butterflies migrate thousands of miles to warmer places each fall.
Huge herds of zebras migrate to find fresh grass.
Some whales migrate thousands of miles every year.

easy.def: Silly things that can cause a little trouble.
examples: The puppy got into mischief.
My kitten is full of mischief.
The kids got into mischief in the mud.

more.def: Playful behavior that causes trouble or annoys people.
examples: The twins were always up to some kind of mischief.
The monkey's mischief made the zookeeper laugh.
There was a look of mischief in her eyes.
The soil is moist after the rain.
The cake is moist and soft.
A frog has moist skin.
Keep the seeds in moist soil until they sprout.
The dog's nose was cool and moist.
Moist air from the ocean brought fog.
There is snow on top of the mountain.
We drove up the mountain.
A goat lives on the mountain.

more.def: A very high area of land, much taller than a hill.
examples: It took the climbers three days to reach the top of the mountain.
The mountain was hidden in clouds.
A cold stream runs down the side of the mountain.

easy.def: A place where you can look at old or special things.
examples: We saw old bones at the museum.
The museum has old trains.
We saw art at the museum.

more.def: A building where interesting objects of art, history, or science are kept and shown.
examples: The museum has a real rocket hanging from the ceiling.
The science museum lets you touch the displays.
The town's museum tells the story of its first settlers.

easy.def: Something we do not understand or know yet.
examples: Who took the cookie? It is a mystery!
My book is a mystery.
Where the cat goes at night is a mystery.

more.def: Something that is hard to explain or that has not been solved.
examples: How the huge stones were moved is still a mystery.
The detective solved the mystery of the missing ring.
Deep space is still full of mystery.
